summary: mmjahanara 与 Pierre 分析指出，虫洞（EIP-7503）的可信否认属性与以太坊 160 位地址并不兼容，并重新审视 EIP-7503 宣称的匿名集。miha-stopar 讨论 FHE 是否值得如此关注：它承诺在加密状态上做通用可组合计算，且不依赖可信硬件。

items.note: （Pierre）18:21：说明虫洞的可信否认属性似乎与以太坊 160 位地址不兼容，并剖析 EIP-7503 宣称的匿名集。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Wormholes and the cost of plausible deniability
items.note_en: (Pierre), 18:21: explains why wormholes' plausible deniability seems incompatible with Ethereum's 160 bit addresses and examines EIP-7503's claimed anonymity set.

items.title: ethresear.ch：FHE 值得这么多关注吗？
items.note: （miha-stopar）00:19：FHE 承诺在加密状态上做完全通用、可组合的计算，且不依赖可信硬件。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Does FHE deserve this much attention?
items.note_en: (miha-stopar), 00:19: FHE promises fully general, composable computation over encrypted state without trusted hardware.

summary_en: mmjahanara and Pierre argued that the plausible deniability of wormholes (EIP-7503) is incompatible with Ethereum's 160 bit addresses, and revisited EIP-7503's claimed anonymity set. miha-stopar asked whether FHE deserves its attention, given its promise of general composable computation over encrypted state without trusted hardware.
